headings: XPHOZAH for Hyperphosphatemia in CKD Patients on Dialysis
Label Extension for IBSRELA to Treat Patients with CIC
paragraphs: We are a commercial-stage biopharmaceutical company focused on the development and commercialization of innovative medicines that meet significant unmet medical needs. We currently market two therapies from the active ingredient tenapanor, a sodium/hydrogen exchanger (NHE3) inhibitor that was discovered and developed by Ardelyx. NHE3 is an antiporter expressed on the apical surface of the small and large intestines. Tenapanor is a minimally absorbed, first-in-class, oral, small molecule therapy.

Tenapanor, branded as IBSRELA®, is approved in the U.S. for the treatment of adults with irritable bowel syndrome with constipation. We believe that IBSRELA can bring meaningful benefit to the approximately 13 million Americans who suffer from the symptoms of IBS-C, many of whom continue to experience symptoms despite intervention with other therapies. We are seeking to further expand the IBSRELA eligible patient population to include patients with chronic idiopathic constipation (CIC), and have initiated a Phase 3 clinical trial evaluating tenapanor in adult CIC patients.

Tenapanor, branded as XPHOZAH®, is approved in the U.S. to reduce serum phosphorus in adults with chronic kidney disease on dialysis as add-on therapy in patients who have an inadequate response to phosphate binders or who are intolerant of any dose of phosphate binder therapy. We believe XPHOZAH can bring meaningful relief to adult chronic kidney disease patients on dialysis, the vast majority of whom have elevated levels of serum phosphorus and are unable to achieve target serum phosphorus levels with phosphate binders alone. Continually elevated levels of serum phosphorus can result in severe cardiovascular health complications.
In addition to commercializing IBSRELA and XPHOZAH, we are also developing a next-generation NHE3 inhibitor that we believe can have application across multiple therapeutic areas.
Refer to the Summary of Abbreviated Terms at the end of this Annual Report on Form 10-K for definitions of terms used throughout the document.

We are committed to our mission of developing and commercializing innovative medicines that address unmet patient needs. Our principal strategy is to continue our commercial momentum with our current products while advancing and expanding a portfolio of important medicines for patients with unmet medical needs.

Our priorities include (i) driving significant IBSRELA growth, (ii) maintaining XPHOZAH commercial momentum, (iii) further advancing our pipeline and portfolio and (iv) maintaining a solid financial foundation to support our future growth.

We have incurred losses in each year since our inception in October 2007. We continue to incur commercialization, development and additional expenses related to our ongoing operations and pursuit of future business opportunities. We have historically funded our operations primarily from product sales, sales of our common stock, funds from our loan agreements with SLR, funds from our collaboration partnerships, as well as the sale of future royalties and commercialization milestones to HCR. We expect that we will increasingly rely on cash generated from our commercial operations to fund our operating plan while maintaining financial flexibility to source cash from future equity sales and debt financing.

IBSRELA is a first-in-class NHE3 inhibitor approved by the FDA for the treatment of IBS-C in adults. IBSRELA acts locally in the gut and is minimally absorbed. IBS-C is a gastrointestinal disorder characterized by both constipation and abdominal pain. IBS-C is associated with significantly impaired quality of life, reduced productivity and substantial economic burden. We recognized our first sales of IBSRELA in the U.S. in March 2022.

We deploy a market-responsive commercial strategy for IBSRELA and have a commercial organization highly experienced in commercializing novel therapies in specialty areas. The dynamics of the IBS-C market reflect an established patient base, limited number of competitors all confined to a single mechanism of action (secretagogues), concentrated number of prescribers who see a large number of IBS-C patients, and recognized unmet need. These dynamics enable a targeted promotional focus on IBS-C patients currently being managed by high-writing healthcare providers. Central to our commercial strategy for IBSRELA has been our highly experienced specialty sales force, many with existing relationships across their gastrointestinal target base,
omnichannel digital initiatives and our patient services programs, including ArdelyxAssist, that support patient access to our therapies.
We believe competition for IBSRELA comes largely from prescription products indicated for IBS-C: branded products, Linzess (linaclotide) and Trulance (plecanatide), as well as generic lubiprostone.

In January 2026, we initiated ACCEL (ten-03-301), a Phase 3 clinical trial designed to assess the safety and efficacy of tenapanor for the treatment of CIC. Enrollment in ACCEL is expected throughout 2026, with topline data read out in the second half of 2027. CIC is characterized by difficult, infrequent or incomplete bowel movements, and is associated with significantly impaired quality of life, disrupted productivity and high healthcare-related costs and is estimated to affect more than 34 million Americans.

XPHOZAH was approved by the FDA in October 2023. XPHOZAH is a first-in-class phosphate absorption inhibitor approved in the U.S. to reduce serum phosphorus in adults with CKD on dialysis as add-on therapy in patients who have an inadequate response to phosphate binders or who are intolerant of any dose of phosphate binder therapy. XPHOZAH has a differentiated mechanism of action and acts locally in the gut to inhibit NHE3. This results in the tightening of the epithelial cell junctions, thereby significantly reducing paracellular uptake of phosphate, the primary pathway of phosphate absorption. It is estimated that there are more than 550,000 adult patients with CKD on dialysis in the U.S. and approximately 80% of those patients are being treated with phosphate lowering therapies. In addition, approximately 70% of patients treated with phosphate binders to treat hyperphosphatemia were unable to consistently maintain phosphorous levels <=5.5 mg/dL over a six-month period. XPHOZAH is the first therapy for phosphate management that blocks phosphate absorption at the primary site of uptake. We recognized our first sales of XPHOZAH in the U.S. in December 2023.

headings: Risks Related to our Financial Condition and Capital Requirements
Our ability to utilize our net operating loss carryforwards and certain other tax attributes may be limited.
Principal Risks Related to Our Business
IBSRELA and/or XPHOZAH may cause undesirable side effects or have other properties that could limit the commercial success of the products.
Our future results depend on CMOs, many of whom are our single source manufacturers.
Additional Risks Related to Our Business and Industry
We face substantial competition, and our competitors may discover, develop or commercialize products faster or more successfully than us.
We may experience difficulties in managing our current activities and growth given our level of managerial, operational, financial and other resources.
We may engage in strategic transactions that could impact our liquidity, increase our expenses and present significant distractions to our management.
If product liability lawsuits are brought against us, we may incur substantial liabilities and may be required to limit commercialization of IBSRELA and/or XPHOZAH.
If we fail to attract, retain and motivate our executives, senior management and key personnel, our business will suffer.
paragraphs: Our business involves significant risks, some of which are described below. You should carefully consider these risks, as well as other information in this Annual Report on Form 10-K, including our financial statements and the notes thereto and "Management's Discussion and Analysis of Financial Condition and Results of Operations." The occurrence of any of the events or developments described below could harm our business, financial condition, results of operations, cash flows, the trading price of our common stock and our growth prospects. Additional risks and uncertainties not presently known to us or that we currently deem immaterial may also impair our business operations.

We have incurred losses in each year since our inception, and if we are unable to continue to increase revenue and/or, depending upon our pursuit of future business opportunities, we may not achieve expected cash flow positivity, and even if we do, we may not be able to sustain cash flow positivity quarter over quarter and year over year.

In March 2022, we commenced the commercialization of our first product, IBSRELA® (tenapanor) for the treatment of IBS-C in adult patients. In November 2023, we commenced the commercialization of XPHOZAH® (tenapanor) for the reduction of serum phosphorus in adults with CKD on dialysis as add-on therapy in patients who have an inadequate response to phosphate binders or who are intolerant of any dose of phosphate binder therapy.

We have incurred losses in each year since our inception in October 2007. We continue to incur commercialization, development and additional expenses related to our ongoing operations and pursuit of future business opportunities. As of December 31, 2025, we had an accumulated deficit of $946.9 million. Our prior losses, combined with any future losses, have had and will continue to have an adverse effect on our stockholders' equity and working capital.

If we are unable to continue to increase revenue for IBSRELA and XPHOZAH, and/or if we elect to pursue future business opportunities to strengthen our pipeline, we may not achieve expected cash flow positivity, and even if we do, we may not be able to sustain cash flow positivity quarter over quarter and year over year.

Our ability to achieve and sustain cash flow positivity quarter over quarter and year over year depends heavily on our ability to successfully commercialize IBSRELA and XPHOZAH and on the decisions we may make to expand our pipeline through internal investment and/or acquiring external assets. In addition, our cash flow positivity may be impacted by the costs of our ongoing development efforts, including our Phase 3 clinical trial evaluating tenapanor in CIC and our RDX10531 development program.

Tenapanor, branded as XPHOZAH®, is approved in the U.S. to reduce serum phosphorus in adults with chronic kidney disease on dialysis as add-on therapy in patients who have an inadequate response to phosphate binders or who are intolerant of any dose of phosphate binder therapy. In February 2025, we announced the NDA approval by China's Center for Drug Evaluation of the NMPA for tenapanor in the control of serum phosphorus in adult patients with CKD on hemodialysis. This approval triggered a $5.0 million milestone to us under the terms of the Fosun Agreement, which was recorded as licensing revenue on our statements of operations and comprehensive loss when earned during the 2025 first quarter and was received in April 2025.

As of the end of the 2025 second quarter, we had fully recognized the maximum $75.0 million royalty obligation, which had been fully remitted as of the end of the 2025 third quarter under the AstraZeneca Termination Agreement.

On June 30, 2025, we entered into an amendment to our 2022 Loan Agreement (the Fifth Amendment), by and among the Company, as borrower, SLR, as collateral agent and the lenders party thereto. The Fifth Amendment, among other things, (i) provided for the immediate draw of $50.0 million of the Term E Loan on the closing date of the Fifth Amendment; and (ii) provides us with the option to draw an additional $100.0 million of committed senior secured term loans, consisting of the Term F Loan and the Term G Loan, each in the amount of $50.0 million. The Term F Loan and the Term G Loan may be drawn at the Company's election by June 30, 2026 and December 20, 2026, respectively.

In September 2025, we submitted an IND application to the FDA for IBSRELA to expand the IBSRELA eligible patient population to include patients with CIC. In January 2026, we initiated ACCEL (ten-03-301), a Phase 3 clinical trial designed to assess the safety and efficacy of tenapanor for the treatment of CIC. CIC is characterized by difficult, infrequent or incomplete bowel movements, and is associated with significantly impaired quality of life, disrupted productivity and high healthcare-related costs. CIC is estimated to affect more than 34 million Americans. Pending the outcome of the Phase 3 clinical trial, if successful, we intend to submit a supplemental NDA to the FDA for tenapanor for the CIC indication.

In October 2025, we announced a development program for RDX10531. We believe RDX10531 is a next-generation NHE3 inhibitor with potential application across multiple therapeutic areas. We are currently conducting activities to support an IND submission to the FDA for RDX10531 in the second half of 2026.

paragraphs: 本公司為一家商業階段的生物製藥公司，專注於開發與商業化創新藥物，以解決重要的未滿足醫療需求。本公司目前行銷兩種療法，皆為活性成分 tenapanor，一種由 Ardelyx 發現並開發的鈉/氫交換體（NHE3）抑制劑。NHE3 是一種在小腸與大腸上皮表面表達的反向運輸蛋白。Tenapanor 是一種吸收極低、第一類口服小分子療法。

Tenapanor 以 IBSRELA® 品牌上市，已獲美國核准用於治療患有便祕型腸易激綜合症（IBS-C）的成人。本公司認為 IBSRELA 可為約 13 百萬美國患者帶來有意義的療效，許多患者即使接受其他療法後，仍持續出現症狀。本公司正尋求進一步擴大 IBSRELA 可適用患者羣，包含慢性特發性便祕（CIC）患者，並已啟動一項第三期臨牀試驗，評估 tenapanor 在成人 CIC 患者中的療效。

Tenapanor 以 XPHOZAH® 品牌上市，已獲美國核准用於降低慢性腎臟病患者在透析治療中血清磷水平，作為磷酸結合劑療法無法達到足夠療效或患者對任何劑量的磷酸結合劑療法不耐受時的附加療法。本公司認為 XPHOZAH 可為接受透析治療的慢性腎臟病成人患者帶來有意義的緩解，這些患者大多數血清磷水平升高，且單獨使用磷酸結合劑無法達到目標血清磷水平。持續升高的血清磷水平可能導致嚴重的心血管健康問題。
除了商業化 IBSRELA 和 XPHOZAH，本公司也正在開發新一代 NHE3 抑制劑，本公司認為該藥物可能在多個治療領域有應用潛力。
請參閱本年度 10-K 申報文件末尾的縮寫詞彙表，以取得文中使用之術語的定義。
本公司致力於開發與商業化創新藥物，以解決未滿足患者的醫療需求。本公司主要策略為持續推進現有產品的商業化動能，同時進展並擴展針對未滿足醫療需求患者的藥物組合。
本公司優先事項包括（i）推動 IBSRELA 的顯著成長，（ii）維持 XPHOZAH 的商業動能，（iii）進一步進展我們的藥物研發與組合，以及（iv）維持堅實的財務基礎，以支持未來的成長。
自本公司於 2007 年 10 月成立以來，每年均產生虧損。本公司持續產生與商業化、研發及未來商業機會相關的費用。本公司歷來主要透過產品銷售、本公司普通股的發行、貸款協議與 SLR 的資金、合作夥伴關係的資金，以及未來 royalty 與商業化里程碑收入至 HCR 來資助營運。本公司預期將越來越依賴商業化營運所產生的現金，以支應營運計畫，同時維持財務彈性，以從未來的股票發行與債務融資中籌措現金。
IBSRELA 是美國食品藥物管理局核准的第一個 NHE3 抑製劑，用於治療成人之腸易激綜合症便祕型 (IBS-C)。IBSRELA 在腸道內作用，並被吸收程度極低。IBS-C 是一種腸胃道疾病，特徵為便祕與腹部疼痛。IBS-C 會顯著影響生活品質、降低生產力，並造成相當大的經濟負擔。我們在 2022 年 3 月美國首次銷售 IBSRELA。

我們針對 IBSRELA 運用市場反應型商業策略，並擁有經驗豐富的商業團隊，專門於在專門領域商業化創新療法。IBS-C 市場的動態反映了一個已建立的患者羣體、有限的競爭對手，所有競爭對手都僅限於單一作用機制 (secretagogues)，集中於見到大量 IBS-C 患者之處方醫師，以及被認可的未滿足需求。這些動態使我們能針對目前由高處方率醫療提供者管理的 IBS-C 患者進行定向宣傳。我們針對 IBSRELA 的商業策略核心為我們經驗豐富的專門領域銷售團隊，許多成員在他們的腸胃道目標羣體中已有既有的關係，
全通路數位計畫與我們的患者服務方案，包括 ArdelyxAssist，以支持患者取得我們的療法。
我們認為 IBSRELA 的競爭主要來自於核准用於 IBS-C 的處方藥物：品牌藥物，Linzess (linaclotide) 和 Trulance (plecanatide)，以及通用藥物 lubiprostone。
2026 年 1 月，我們啟動了 ACCEL (ten-03-301)，這是一個第三期臨牀試驗，旨在評估 tenapanor 對治療 CIC 的安全性與有效性。ACCEL 的招募預計於 2026 年進行，並在 2027 年第二季公佈初步數據。CIC 的特徵為排便困難、頻率低或不完全，並與顯著影響生活品質、幹擾生產力及高醫療相關成本有關，估計影響美國超過 34 百萬人。

XPHOZAH 於 2023 年 10 月獲美國食品藥物管理局核准。XPHOZAH 是美國核准的第一個磷酸鹽吸收抑制劑，用於降低正在進行血液透析之慢性腎臟病 (CKD) 成人患者之血清磷酸鹽濃度，作為磷酸鹽結合劑療法無法達到足夠療效或對任何劑量之磷酸鹽結合劑療法不耐受患者的附加療法。XPHOZAH 具有區別性的作用機制，並在腸道內作用以抑制 NHE3。這會導致上皮細胞連接處收縮，從而顯著減少磷酸鹽的旁細胞吸收，這是磷酸鹽吸收的主要途徑。估計美國有超過 550,000 名成人慢性腎臟病患者正在進行血液透析，其中約 80% 的患者正在接受降低磷酸鹽的療法。此外，約 70% 接受磷酸鹽結合劑治療高磷酸血癥的患者，在六個月期間無法持續維持磷酸鹽濃度 <=5.5 mg/dL。XPHOZAH 是第一種在磷酸鹽吸收主要吸收部位阻斷磷酸鹽吸收的療法。我們在 2023 年 12 月美國首次銷售 XPHOZAH。

執行摘要與財務重點
本公司為一家商業階段之生技藥品公司，專注於開發與商業化創新藥物，以解決重大未被滿足之醫療需求。本公司目前行銷兩種以活性成分 tenapanor 為基礎之療法，tenapanor 為一種 NHE3 抑制劑，由 Ardelyx 發現與開發。NHE3 為一種反向運輸蛋白，表達於小腸與大腸之頂面。tenapanor 為一種吸收極低、第一類口服小分子藥物。
tenapanor，品牌為 IBSRELA®，已於美國核准用於治療有便祕型腸躁症之成人。本公司認為 IBSRELA 可為約 13 百萬美國患者帶來有意義之效益，這些患者皆有腸躁症便祕之症狀，許多患者即使接受其他療法後，仍持續有症狀。本公司正尋求進一步擴大 IBSRELA 可適用之患者羣，包括有慢性便祕之患者，並已啟動一項第三期臨牀試驗，評估 tenapanor 在成人慢性便祕患者之應用。
tenapanor，品牌為 XPHOZAH®，已於美國核准用於降低慢性腎臟病患者在透析治療中之血清磷含量，作為磷酸結合劑療法無法達到足夠療效或對任何劑量之磷酸結合劑療法不耐受之患者之附加療法。本公司認為 XPHOZAH 可為接受透析治療之慢性腎臟病成人患者帶來有意義之緩解，這些患者大多數有高血清磷含量，且無法單獨透過磷酸結合劑達到目標血清磷含量。持續升高之血清磷含量可能導致嚴重之心血管健康問題。
除了商業化 IBSRELA 與 XPHOZAH 之外，本公司亦在開發新一代之 NHE3 抑制劑，本公司認為此藥物可能在多個治療領域有應用潛力。

本公司致力於開發與商業化創新藥物，以解決未被滿足之患者需求。本公司之主要策略為持續以現有產品維持商業動能，同時推進並擴展對未被滿足醫療需求之重要藥物組合。
本公司優先事項包括 (i) 帶動重大 IBSRELA 成長、(ii) 維持 XPHOZAH 商業動能、(iii) 進一步推進我們的產品管道與產品組合、以及 (iv) 維持穩健的財務基礎以支持我們未來的成長。
2025 年 2 月，我們宣佈中國國家藥品監督管理局藥物評價中心已批准 tenapanor 用於控制成人慢性腎臟病患者在血液透析時的血清磷含量。此批准使我們根據 Fosun 合約條款取得 5.0 百萬美元的里程碑金額，該金額已記入我們營業收入及綜合損益表中，於 2025 年第一季取得，並於 2025 年 4 月收到。
截至 2025 年第二季末，我們已完全確認最高 75.0 百萬美元的版稅義務，該義務已於 2025 年第三季末根據 AstraZeneca 終止協議全部支付完畢。

於 2025 年 6 月 30 日，本公司與 SLR 及貸款人簽訂 2022 年貸款協議（第五修正案）。第五修正案除其他事項外，(i) 在第五修正案簽訂日，提供立即提取 50.0 百萬美元的 Term E 貸款；以及 (ii) 本公司得選擇提取額外 100.0 百萬美元的已承諾優先 secured 期貨貸款，包含 Term F 貸款及 Term G 貸款，各為 50.0 百萬美元。Term F 貸款及 Term G 貸款可於 2026 年 6 月 30 日及 2026 年 12 月 20 日，由本公司選擇提取。

於 2025 年 9 月，本公司向 FDA 提交 IND 申請，以將 IBSRELA 可適用患者族羣擴展至包含 CIC 患者。於 2026 年 1 月，本公司啟動 ACCEL（ten-03-301），一項 III 期臨牀試驗，用以評估 tenapanor 對 CIC 治療的安全性與有效性。ACCEL 的入組預計於 2026 年進行，主要數據預計於 2027 年第二季公佈。CIC 係指困難、稀少或不完全的排便，與顯著影響生活品質、幹擾生產力及高醫療相關成本有關。CIC 被估計影響美國超過 34 百萬人。待 III 期臨牀試驗結果，若成功，本公司有意向 FDA 提交一份 supplemental NDA，以 tenapanor 用於 CIC 指示。
於 2025 年 10 月，本公司宣佈 RDX10531 的開發計畫。本公司認為 RDX10531 是新一代 NHE3 抑製劑，具備在多個治療領域的應用潛力。目前本公司正進行活動，以支持於 2026 年第二季提交 RDX10531 的 IND 申請至 FDA。

headings: 與我們財務狀況及資金需求相關的風險
本公司利用淨營業虧損結轉及某些其他稅務屬性之能力可能受到限制。
與我們業務相關的主要風險
IBSRELA 及/或 XPHOZAH 可能導致不尋常的副作用或具其他特性，可能限制產品的商業成功。
我們未來的營運成果取決於 CMOs，其中許多為我們的單一來源製造商。
與我們業務及產業相關的其他風險
我們面臨激烈的競爭，競爭對手可能比我們更快或更成功地發現、開發或商業化產品。
我們可能因管理層、營運、財務及其他資源水平而遭遇管理當前業務及成長的困難。

paragraphs: 本公司業務涉及許多重大風險，部分風險已於下文說明。請謹慎考量這些風險，以及本年度報表（Form 10-K）中其他資訊，包括財務報表及其附註，以及『管理層對財務狀況與營運成果之討論與分析』。上述任何事件或發展之發生，可能對本公司業務、財務狀況、營運成果、現金流、普通股交易價格及成長前景造成損害。此外，尚有其他未為本公司所知或目前認為不重要之風險與不確定因素，也可能影響本公司業務營運。
自本公司成立以來，每年均產生虧損，若本公司無法持續增加營業收入，或根據本公司對未來業務機會之追求，可能無法達成預期之現金流為正，即使達成，也可能無法維持每季及每年之現金流為正。
2022年3月，本公司開始商業化本公司首款產品IBSRELA®（tenapanor）用於治療成人之IBS-C。2023年11月，本公司開始商業化XPHOZAH®（tenapanor）用於降低接受透析治療之成人慢性腎臟病患者之血清磷含量，作為磷酸結合劑療法反應不足或無法耐受任何劑量之磷酸結合劑療法之附加治療。
若本公司無法持續增加IBSRELA及XPHOZAH之營業收入，且/或若本公司選擇追求未來業務機會以強化產品線，可能無法達成預期之現金流為正，即使達成，也可能無法維持每季及每年之現金流為正。
本公司能否達成及維持每季及每年之現金流為正，嚴重依賴本公司能否成功商業化IBSRELA及XPHOZAH，以及本公司可能做出之擴充產品線之決定，包括透過內部投資及/或取得外部資產。此外，本公司之現金流為正可能受本公司持續開發努力之成本影響，包括評估tenapanor在CIC之Phase 3臨牀試驗及RDX10531開發計畫之成本。
